package.description: Run agent CLIs in real Windows pseudoconsoles, and stay in charge of them.

en-US.description: Run agent CLIs in real Windows pseudoconsoles, and stay in charge of them.
en-US.longDescription:
MUXFleet runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and other agent CLIs in real Windows
pseudoconsoles owned by a daemon, so a session outlives the terminal that
started it. mf ls shows which agent is waiting for you, a toast tells you
when one is, mf resume brings the fleet back after a reboot, and a bare mf
opens the fleet view.
en-US.name: MUXFleet
